messages:
Avery: Quick check 1 who wants to go sunset paddleboarding Saturday (6:30pm) vs backyard BBQ potluck at my place (5pm)? :ocean: :sunset: :hamburger:
Sam: Paddleboarding pls. low-effort and scenic. Ill bring life jackets if anyone needs.
Nora: BBQ sounds chill tho. can we do both? paddle then BBQ? :thinking_face:
Jamal: Im down for paddle but I have to be back early. BBQ only if its family-friendly and not loud.
Avery: Could do a short paddle (1.5hr) then BBQ. problem: paddle ends right when BBQ starts. logistics?
Sam: We can shift BBQ to 7:30? Id be late if paddle runs long.
Nora: 7:30 is fine for me. I can bring a salad + speaker. low-key tunes. :headphones:
Jamal: 7:30 works. also FYI I bruised my elbow yesterday so Ill skip paddle if its choppy.
Avery: Sorry about the elbow! No worries. well do a headcount for paddle and leave an option to skip.
sunrise-bot: poll: "Saturday plans" options: [Paddleboarding, BBQ, Paddle then BBQ] votes so far: Paddleboarding (1), BBQ (1), Paddle then BBQ (2)
Sam: Looks like combo is popular. Ill bring the cooler with extra water and some frozen citrus ice packs.
Nora: Ill bring utensils + a veggie tray. Jamal, want me to bring anything thats easy on the elbow?
Jamal: Maybe soft buns and a tofu option would be great. thanks.
Avery: OK final plan: meet at Harbor Launch 6:15 for quick paddle (6:301:30), then BBQ at my place ~7:30. Ill post address in DM. :map:
Sam: Sweet. adding to calendar now. thanks @Avery!
Avery: Thanks everyone 1 see you Saturday :party_parrot:
